title: Bill Moore admits sowing disinformation at MUFON conference
summary: UAPGerb tells of Bill Moore admits sowing disinformation at MUFON conference, about an unknown time at MUFON conference, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, recalls that a UFO writer named Bill Moore stood up at a conference of MUFON, a large American civilian group that investigates UFO reports, and admitted something. According to UAPGerb, Moore said he had been instructed to spread false information among UFO researchers. If true, it would mean someone was deliberately muddying the field from the inside.
